+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+FIREBASE_AUTH_BASE_URL = "https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmailPasswordLoginRequest:
+    email: str
+    password: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmailPasswordLoginTokens:
+    id_token: str
+    refresh_token: str
+    expires_in: int
+    local_id: str
+    email: str
+
+
+class EmailPasswordLoginError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+def _api_key() -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EmailPasswordLoginError("Missing FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY environment variable")
+    return api_key
+
+
+def _normalize_response(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> EmailPasswordLoginTokens:
+    return EmailPasswordLoginTokens(
+        id_token=str(payload["idToken"]),
+        refresh_token=str(payload["refreshToken"]),
+        expires_in=int(payload["expiresIn"]),
+        local_id=str(payload["localId"]),
+        email=str(payload["email"]),
+    )
+
+
+def login_with_email_password(email: str, password: str, timeout: Optional[float] = 30.0) -> EmailPasswordLoginTokens:
+    request = EmailPasswordLoginRequest(email=email, password=password)
+    url = f"{FIREBASE_AUTH_BASE_URL}/accounts:signInWithPassword?key={_api_key()}"
+    response = requests.post(
+        url,
+        json={
+            "email": request.email,
+            "password": request.password,
+            "returnSecureToken": True,
+        },
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    if response.status_code >= 400:
+        try:
+            error_payload = response.json()
+        except ValueError:
+            error_payload = {"error": {"message": response.text}}
+        message = error_payload.get("error", {}).get("message", "UNKNOWN_ERROR")
+        raise EmailPasswordLoginError(f"Firebase sign-in failed: {message}")
+    return _normalize_response(response.json())
+
+
+def login(email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    tokens = login_with_email_password(email, password)
+    return {
+        "id_token": tokens.id_token,
+        "refresh_token": tokens.refresh_token,
+        "expires_in": tokens.expires_in,
+        "local_id": tokens.local_id,
+        "email": tokens.email,
+    }
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RegisterUserResult:
+    user_id: str
+    email: str
+    id_token: Optional[str] = None
+    refresh_token: Optional[str] = None
+    expires_in: Optional[int] = None
+    raw: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
+
+
+def _firebase_api_key() -> str:
+    api_key = os.getenv("FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY") or os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY") or os.getenv("FIREBASE_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("Missing Firebase API key environment variable")
+    return api_key
+
+
+def register_user(email: str, password: str, return_secure_token: bool = True) -> RegisterUserResult:
+    url = f"https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signUp?key={_firebase_api_key()}"
+    payload = {"email": email, "password": password, "returnSecureToken": return_secure_token}
+    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=30)
+    data = response.json()
+    if response.status_code >= 400:
+        message = data.get("error", {}).get("message", "registration_failed")
+        raise RuntimeError(message)
+    return RegisterUserResult(
+        user_id=data["localId"],
+        email=data.get("email", email),
+        id_token=data.get("idToken"),
+        refresh_token=data.get("refreshToken"),
+        expires_in=int(data["expiresIn"]) if data.get("expiresIn") is not None else None,
+        raw=data,
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: register_user.py EMAIL PASSWORD")
+    result = register_user(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
+    print(json.dumps(result.__dict__))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
